# REFI-QDA Project schema

`Project.xsd` is the unmodified REFI-QDA Project 1.0 schema (18 March 2019), retained for offline regression validation. Specification 1.5 uses this 1.0 XML namespace; a `project:2.0` namespace is not defined by this specification.

- Standard and official download page: https://www.qdasoftware.org/project-implementation-files
- Specification: https://openqda.github.io/refi-tools/docs/standard/REFI-QDA-1-5.pdf
- Schema mirror: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openqda/refi-tools/main/docs/schemas/project/v1.0/Project.xsd
